title: ZotFlag
text:
ZotFlag infographic


Zotero Extension (7 to 10) that automatically adds tags to selected references when their metadata matches lists kept in CSV files.

GitHub Repository
Specifications (Pascal Martinolli, 2025).

GPL-3.0-or-later. Author: Pascal Martinolli (specifications); code generated with Claude.
\* : « Make it so. » Catchphrase by Gene Roddenberry, inpired by British navy officers of the XIXe century, first used in “Encounter At Farpoint” (28 September 1987) and reused with much delight by Captain Jean-Luc Picard during the run of ST:TNG.
